title: DeviceGPT: Battery Health
fullDescription:
🔍 DeviceGPT is the battery health and phone health check app for Android. One scan covers battery health, phone diagnostics, hardware test, mic/camera privacy, spyware detection, network speed, and phone condition with resale value — explained in plain English by AI.

No confusing graphs. No root. Just scan → understand → fix.

🔋 Battery Health — What Android Doesn’t Show You

Android has no built-in battery health screen. DeviceGPT fills that gap:

• Real battery health status, temperature, and degradation signals
• Power consumption in watts — per app, per hour
• Charging behavior and cycle tracking
• Which apps drain your battery the most
• Export battery data to CSV or Ask AI for a plain-English explanation

If you’ve searched “battery health android”, “check phone battery health”, or “best battery health app” — this is it.

📱 Phone Health Check — One Scan, Full Picture

• Phone health score covering battery, storage, RAM, temperature, and sensors
• Phone hardware test: touchscreen, speakers, mic, camera, GPS, accelerometer
• Device info: specs, system details, build info — a device info app built into your diagnostics
• Certified phone report with resale value and shareable verification code

🔒 Spyware Detector & Phone Security Check

• See which apps used your microphone or camera and when
• Detect suspicious background activity and data collection
• Spot fake GPS or sensor spoofing
• AI-powered privacy recommendations
• No root required — a practical phone security check, not antivirus

If you’ve asked “is my phone hacked?” — DeviceGPT gives you a structured answer.

📊 Phone Condition Check & Resale Value

Generate a certified phone report for resale, support tickets, or proof of condition. Battery health, hardware test results, storage, and diagnostics — everything a buyer or support agent needs. Verified reports with a shareable code.

🤖 Ask AI — Plain English, Only When You Choose

Tap Ask AI after any scan. We prefill a smart prompt for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot & more:

“Battery is overheating, try reducing background apps.”
“Mic was used last night, consider revoking app permissions.”
“Wi-Fi jitter may affect gaming, restart router.”

Your data stays on-device unless you share it.

🚀 Also Includes

• Wi-Fi speed test and signal strength
• Lock screen widget (Android 13+): health score, battery, temperature at a glance
• Global leaderboard — compare your device anonymously
• Works offline (most features)
• No account required

📱 Ideal For

Anyone asking “Why is my phone slow, hot, or weird?”
People checking battery health on Android
Developers running phone hardware tests
Parents checking kids’ phones for privacy
Sellers needing a phone condition check with resale value

DeviceGPT Premium removes ads and supports ongoing development.

Download DeviceGPT — the phone health check app with battery health, Android diagnostics, and AI-powered reports. Your phone deserves better answers.
